1.title: Trust-Aware Consent Creation
1.require: Patient identity I~p~, authorised doctor D, guardian set G, purpose P~u~, data scope S~C~, validity interval T, jurisdiction L
lines: ⟦b⟧Validate authorised doctor D, guardian set G, purpose P~u~ and data scope S~C~   ▷ in the prototype, D is checked for DID format only at the access decision⟦/b⟧
⟦b⟧**if** G = ∅, any member of G is invalid, P~u~ is invalid, or S~C~ = ∅ **then**⟦/b⟧
Validate jurisdiction L and define authorisation requirement A
⟦b⟧Construct C = (I, A, P, T, L, E) with identifier id~C~, where I holds I~p~ and D, A holds G and the threshold N = |G|, and P holds P~u~ and S~C~⟦/b⟧
⟦b⟧state ← PENDING_SIGNATURE   ▷ nothing is anchored on-chain until all guardians approve⟦/b⟧

2.title: DID and VC Identity and Authority Verification
2.ensure: ⟦b⟧Verification result V~I~(u) ∈ {VALID, INVALID}, where VALID corresponds to V~I~(u) = 1⟦/b⟧
lines: Verify DID document and associated identity information
Verify VC signature, issuer, subject, and validity
Extract role and authority claims from VC
**if** claims do not satisfy the authority requirements of C **then**
Record identity and authority verification evidence

3.title: Threshold-Based Multi-Party Authorisation
3.require: Consent object C with identifier id~C~, purpose P~u~, interval (t~s~, t~e~) and jurisdiction L, patient and requester addresses addr~p~, addr~r~, EIP-712 domain⟦b⟧, signing address Addr(g) of each guardian, burn authorisation burnAuth = 2 (the issuer and the owner may both burn the token)⟦/b⟧, approval a = (g, sig~a~) submitted by guardian g
lines: Verify identity and authority of g (Algorithm 2, a structural DID check in the prototype), and **if** the verification fails **then** report the invalid approval and **return** DENY
signer ← RecoverEIP712(domain, {id~C~, g, APPROVE}, sig~a~)   ▷ off-chain recovery
**if** signer ≠ Addr(g), or the signature binds a different consent, guardian, or chain **then**
Record invalid approval   ▷ shown in the interface in the prototype
Record unauthorised approval attempt   ⟦b⟧▷ in the prototype, only members of G can be selected in the guardian view, and a signature from any other signer is not counted towards N⟦/b⟧
Record duplicate approval   ▷ shown in the interface in the prototype
⟦b⟧R⟦/b⟧ecord a local token identifier and set state ← ACTIVE once t~s~ has been reached

submit mintConsentV3(addr~p~, addr~r~, P~u~, t~s~, t~e~, L, burnAuth) via the owner account   ▷ the contract stores keccak256(P~u~), runs as a background job and is reconciled on request from the guardian view
⟦b⟧On confirmation,⟦/b⟧ replace the local token identifier with the on-chain token identifier
**return** ACTIVATED   ▷ activation is distinct from the access decision
Record threshold-pending event   ▷ shown in the interface in the prototype

4.title: Policy-Aware Access Decision
4.require: Consent object C, access request R = (u, P~R~, S~R~, Jur(R)), requesting participant u, current time t
lines: Verify DID and VC of u
Report the refusal in the doctor interface   ▷ not written to the audit ledger in the prototype
Evaluate requested purpose   ▷ in the prototype, the request purpose is the consent purpose
Record denied decision   ⟦b⟧▷ in the prototype, an empty request is stopped by the interface and is not written to the audit ledger⟦/b⟧
**if** t < t~s~ or t > t~e~ **then** Record denied decision and **return** DENY **end if**
**if** ⟦b⟧Jur(C) ≠ ∅ and ⟦/b⟧Jur(R) ≠ Jur(C) **then** Record denied decision and **return** DENY **end if**
Generate and verify a Groth16 proof that Poseidon(secret, expiry) equals the public commitment and that t ≤ t~e~, and record proof_mode = groth16
⟦b⟧**if** the proof does not verify **then** Record denied decision and **return** DENY **end if**⟦/b⟧

5.title: Temporal and Lifecycle Validation
5.require: Consent object C, current time t, requested transition q
lines: Retrieve consent start time t~s~ and expiry time t~e~
Retrieve current lifecycle state of C
**if** current state does not permit the requested operation **then**
Check whether C has been revoked
Record valid temporal and lifecycle evidence

6.title: Formal and Empirical Authorisation Validation
6.require: Framework implementation F, validation scenarios S, security properties P
lines: **for** each scenario s in S~valid~ ∪ S~negative~ ∪ S~adv~ **do**
Collect identity, approval, policy, and audit evidence
Compare observed decision with expected decision
